Maximize metabolic processes and minimize tension by adding this essential mineral to the daily regimen. Magnesium Glycinate is a bioavailable form of magnesium that supports restful sleep, and a relaxed body and mind.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take 1 capsule daily, or as directed by a healthcare practitioner.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: If you are pregnant or lactating, have any health condition or are taking any medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use. Store in a cool, dry place, tightly capped, away from light. Keep out of the reach of children. Use only if safety seal is intact. Variations in product color may occur.
